//: Default Cynara API configuration. Connection strings and other secrets MUST come from environment variables (ConnectionStrings__Default, OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.) — never from this file. For local development the defaults below point at the docker-stack Postgres (docker/stack.yml); in any deployed environment the corresponding env var on the host overrides these values.

Cors.//: Origins allowed to call the API via browser fetch / XHR. Replace with the real cynara-web origin in the environment-specific override.

ConnectionStrings.//: The infrastructure layer picks one of these named connection strings based on ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: 'Production' selects 'Prod', any other value selects 'Default'. In deployed environments set ConnectionStrings__Prod (and optionally ConnectionStrings__Default) as env vars — they override these defaults without touching the file.

Hospitals.//: Bootstrap workspace created on first boot when AllowAutoBootstrap is true. HeaderName is the request header used to resolve the hospital tenant on every call.

SonarQube.//: Local SonarQube connection used by Cursor MCP servers (.cursor/sonarqube-mcp.sh reads these via _read-appsettings-env.sh). URL is the host the MCP container reaches the server on (the docker network 'cynara-net'); the operator-facing URL stays at http://localhost:9000. TokenFile points at the file written by the local bootstrap (scripts/sonar-bootstrap.sh).
